sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.
Our order history for this part shows 28.94 EUR (po:4500010017-10) against 29.89 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is 24.31 EUR (cost:340010).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,400 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified your volume forecast and historical data, which permits a minor adjustment.

Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH does not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We can support the 24-month contract and 42-day lead time at a unit price of EUR 32.10. Specifically, our offer provides a price of €32.10 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed the delivery record data you provided; while accurate, it does not warrant a price reduction. Acknowledging your revised offer, we can make a further concession to EUR 32.00 per unit. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

We require the 42-day lead time to reliably fulfill the 23,400 pieces per year over the 24-month contract. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Accordingly, our offer comprises a price of €32.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
